title: Large-Scale Streaming Portfolio Optimization with Pauli Correlation Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.32769v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classical portfolio construction over large asset universes is a combinatorial selection problem that existing heuristics do not solve well at scale. Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) addresses this by representing the underlying clustering problem with far fewer qubits than one per asset, and a prior study showed it is competitive with classical methods on a single historical snapshot. This paper moves beyond that static test to a streaming deployment, in which the correlation structure and the portfolio are both re-estimated on a rolling basis, as a live rebalancing system would actually operate. We introduce two streaming variants -- PCE itself and a joint multi-cut variant, dPCE -- and evaluate both against a Buy & Hold baseline across window lengths, portfolio sizes up to several thousand assets, risk-aversion and transaction-cost settings, and measurement-shot budgets. translated_title: 基于泡利相关性编码的大规模流式投资组合优化
translated_abstract: 在大规模资产池上进行投资组合构建是一个组合选择问题，现有的启发式方法难以在规模化场景下很好地求解。泡利相关性编码（Pauli Correlation Encoding, PCE）通过使用远少于“每个资产一个量子比特”的量子比特数来表示底层聚类问题，从而解决了这一难题；先前的研究表明，该方法在单一历史快照上与经典方法具有竞争力。本文超越了那种静态测试，转向流式部署——在该部署中，相关性结构与投资组合均以滚动方式重新估计，正如实时再平衡系统实际运行的方式。我们引入了两种流式变体——PCE本身以及联合多切分的dPCE变体——并在窗口长度、高达数千种资产的投资组合规模、风险厌恶与交易成本设置以及测量次数预算等不同条件下，将两者与“买入持有”（Buy & Hold）基线进行对比评估。流式PCE和dPCE始终优于被动基线方法……
tldr: 该论文将泡利相关性编码从静态单点测试推进到流式实时再平衡场景，提出PCE与dPCE两种流式变体，在数千种资产规模及多种参数设置下持续优于“买入持有”等被动基线。
en_tdlr: The paper extends Pauli Correlation Encoding from a static snapshot test to a streaming rebalancing setting, introducing PCE and dPCE variants that consistently outperform passive Buy & Hold baselines across portfolio sizes up to several thousand assets and diverse parameter settings.
